Preserve the entire old complete Array domain and add all existing facts7/HIR8 required ReadSpan parameters, local aliases, direct calls and f64 literal/reference/read/call returns. budgetAccounting.operations: K+C+R+W+S+Q+L+2, with R including standalone checked View reads. Register count P+K+C+R+Q+L; full literal return counted in K. Every exact callback total and existing hard cap checked before output.
budgetAccounting.producer: block callback exactly one, parameter callback once exactP, register/step/line callbacks enforce exact final totals and hard maxima; wrappers/all metadata/arguments/separators/final LF included in8MiB UTF8 output, no partial result

A standalone View read costs one statement+one value+receiver+index=4 actual steps, whereas return/RHS read contribution2*R shares its existing enclosing statement/return accounting. View alias stays2*C; formal View contributes P only. Hard caps remain explicit checked ceilings; do not claim independent per-role maxima are simultaneously admissible or remove limit rejection.
budgetAccounting.symbols: P=parameters,C=locals,E=literal elements,W=stores,S=resizes,R=checked reads,I=literal index occurrences,N=literal newLength,F=literal store RHS,K=E+I+N+F+call literal occurrences; Q=all direct calls,A=all actuals,T=final-return call flag. Existing hard maxima retained. V=local checked-view creates, L=discarded view-length expressions, C includes Array and view locals; K additionally includes literal start/length occurrences, R includes Array and view checked reads. K also includes each literal final f64 return. Formal View parameters contribute P, view_alias contributes C, all View call actuals contribute A; unused formals still have original parameter/metadata registration. D=standalone checked View reads, R includes every return/RHS/standalone checked read exactly once. K includes their index literals and final floating return. callGraph.callPath: No allocation or callLocal is transported as Derived through a cyclic component. Its outgoing reachable domain has no actual allocations/views, so every cyclic Derived owner is one of the current function full Array parameter slots. External fresh actuals are substituted only at their finite incoming call. Allocation imports elsewhere follow the acyclic condensation path, at most15 frames; existing maxItems15 is retained. Effective callLocal never enters Derived or a callee Effective recurrence.
callGraph.classification: A component is cyclic iff it has more than one member or a self-edge. Use all functions/ordinary occurrences without export or entry reachability pruning. Pure graph classification does not change owner meter; source cardinalities bound it.
callGraph.coldConsumer: Compute complete caller→callee transitive closure over every represented function including private/unreachable; each cyclic node and every outgoing reachable function must contain no tsfg_array.create. No need to reject incoming acyclic entry allocation. Keep entry fuel1 in each function; Any actual checked-view creation in that cyclic outgoing domain is also rejected, matching existing upstream policy.
callGraph.eligibility: Only for a graph containing a cycle: validate the entire exact selected facts/HIR and fixed context4 identity/slots/upper/digests first. Form the union of every cyclic SCC and its complete outgoing reachable functions. Every function in this union must use only required Array<f64>/f64/u32 parameters, f64 results, prior Array aliases and existing checked read/store/resize/ordinary calls. Reject any actual local fresh Array literal, any ReadSpan parameter/result/local/use in that union. The restriction is transitive and includes unreachable SCCs. An outside caller may pass its own fresh owner into this domain. Published.local true is not evidence of actual fresh syntax and is allowed.

Missing/invalid fixed preparation base or identity maps to r03-array-hir-context at the five HIR seams, while the four ArrayCalls seams retain original base/identity. A complete no-view DAG retains the existing optional two-argument HIR route.

denseStaticProof.store: for an original literal index and exact length L, reject index>L as a statically proven gap; index==L is allowed append and sets exact L+1 on normal continuation; index<L retains exact L. A parameter index sets unknown on normal continuation. Existing checked operation is always retained. An unknown prior length stays unknown for literal store.
